summary: Tested new user Deactivate and Permanent Delete features (both backend and frontend). All 7 backend pytest cases passed and full end-to-end UI flow verified: create test user -> deactivate (single confirm mentioning data preserved) -> status becomes Inactive -> deactivate button hidden -> permanent delete (double confirm) -> row removed. Also confirmed deactivate button appears only for active users (0 of 23 inactive users had it; all 5 active users had it) and delete button appears for all users.

issues: Missing aria-describedby on DialogContent (a11y warning in console) - low priority

critical_code_review_comments: UserManagementPage.js is 855 lines - consider splitting into smaller components (AddUserDialog, EditUserDialog, ResetPasswordDialog, UsersTable).
handlePermanentDeleteUser uses native browser confirm() dialog with 'Type DELETE mentally' - consider an actual typed-confirmation modal using shadcn Dialog for a stronger safeguard and better UX.
Backend permanently_delete_user checks is_super_admin but not self-delete against super admin explicitly - order is fine but self-delete returns 403 correctly for admin (verified).
DELETE /api/users/{user_id} (deactivate) does not prevent deactivating super admins or self, which may be undesirable.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ user via UI/API during tests; all cleaned up (permanently deleted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New endpoints DELETE /api/users/{id} (soft) and DELETE /api/users/{id}/permanent (hard) working. Frontend uses native confirm() dialogs. data-testid pattern: deactivate-{id}, delete-{id}.
